'''Giva jumbo''' was a beverage served in a bowl by the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] cooks [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] and [[Doodnik Sharpelz]]. It was served in [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] for 2.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
